recent_news.headline: Fuel Crisis: The Answer Might Be Flowing Through Commercial Kitchen Drains
recent_news.summary: Grease Guardian highlights how FOG recovery technology can capture waste from commercial kitchens and convert it to renewable fuel as fuel prices remain unstable. The article discusses automatic grease removal devices and their role in a circular economy approach to waste management.
